data.name: Hilton Porto Gaia
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodation
Experience 5-star luxury at Hilton Porto Gaia, located just 1 km from D. Luis I Bridge. The hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with modern amenities including a coffee machine, minibar, and private bathroom. Some rooms even feature a balcony for stunning views.

Wellness and Dining
Indulge in the hotel's hot tub and hammam for ultimate relaxation. Stay active at the fitness centre, indoor pool, and sauna. Enjoy delicious meals at the on-site restaurant, and choose from a variety of breakfast options to start your day right.

Convenient Location
With a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, and free WiFi, Hilton Porto Gaia ensures a seamless stay. Explore nearby attractions like Sao Bento Metro Station and Ribeira Square. Book now for an unforgettable experience.

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Multiple guests praise exceptional cleanliness (explicitly noted in Spanish/Portuguese reviews); no major cleanliness complaints.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Staff repeatedly described as friendly, attentive and helpful (reception, concierge and restaurant staff positively mentioned).

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Consistently highlighted as excellent: waterfront/river views, close to Ponte Luís and many attractions and restaurants; ideal for walking.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Rooms praised as very spacious with comfortable/large beds and great showers, but several guests noted issues: dim lighting, some defective furniture and slippery shower floors.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Good amenities reported (pool, spa, pleasant bar with river view, comprehensive breakfast); terrace smoking noted as a downside for families.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Mixed signals on price: a few guests explicitly cited cost/value concerns or perceived low cost-benefit.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast repeatedly praised as very good/complete; restaurant space/menu received some criticism and terrace smoking was a complaint.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Overall very positive guest sentiment (many 'excellent', 'spectacular', 'would return'), tempered by specific issues like lighting, shower slip risk and occasional furniture defects.
